integrity: The accompanying analytic proof and exact rational checker establish the stated four-region classification under their explicit normalization; no unproved external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Pure complex degree-three spherical harmonics only; a single full continuously observed latitude with probability-normalized trace.
Optimizes the least squared singular value, not the spectral condition number or finite-sensor placement.
Previously known cubic cap-spectral formulas can imply the unoptimized latitude eigenvalues; priority is claimed only provisionally for the four-regime global optimum.
Earlier Legendre and E-optimal design literature may contain an equivalent result; no independent validation has occurred.
title: Four optimal-latitude regimes for pure cubic spherical harmonics
